scope: Fresh read of the exact current closure registers and the named proof/definition interfaces. No exhaustive claim about all historical results or all usages; no new compiler, CI or theorem promotion.

inventory.authority: Current MATH_CONTRACTS madness_extension registration, not current-head full native acceptance.

finding: No named independently proved closing sign or smallness bound was found in this bounded set. The strongest directly applicable extra finite-input inequalities are actual atom square/concentration bounds and the exact corrected-source discrepancy integral. Ground moments/visibility impose genuine additional constraints only on their selected eigenstates. A new source-specific relation to those states or a paid signed covariance bound remains necessary.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Any actual Euclidean finite vector, fixed K, real 0<=omega<=1; stronger square bound requires omega<=1/2. No eigenvector, stationarity or RH premise.
interfaces.existing_result: The actual source-atom energy is the signed exchange channel; concentration is the SUM of both nonnegative exchange energies. ||S_omega u||^2<=2C_omega(u), improved to <=C_omega(u) on the half interval; full complex mixed pairing is bounded by sqrt(C(h)C(u)).
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This is an available input-specific inequality for the actual finite echo coefficients, not just a generic operator norm. It can price atomwise positive response costs in the current fixed-input analysis without a ground adapter.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: It bounds a positive SUM, not the parity response difference or signed echo. Squaring the full prime sum retains all cross-prime terms. A weighted Cauchy upper must charge the full prime mass; the old overlap is not discardable.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: L>0; all q in Icc 2 floor(exp L), including every prime power. Corrected-row application requires K>=2 and actual pole-neutral even u.
interfaces.existing_result: omega=1-log(q)/L<=1/2 iff log(q)>=L/2. Late atoms have mixed cost1 and old atoms cost2. Complete row cost retains the exact Arch pairing plus the actual concentration sum.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: An actual finer majorant available before replacing concentration by a global norm. DERIVED: with w_q=Lambda(q)/sqrt(q), c_q=1 late/2 old, ||Prime u||^2 <= (sum w_q)(sum w_q c_q C_q(u)). Weighted Cauchy plus the cited actual atom theorem proves this finite bound.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: The unconditional fallback still costs O(exp L)||u||^2 after Chebyshev on sum w_q; it does not supply a subexponential squared-response bound or source-matched signed cancellation. No claim that this family has never been considered elsewhere in the project.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: General identity: C1 complex test with both endpoint values zero and continuous derivative; native specialization: L>0 and actual pole-neutral even u.
interfaces.existing_result: Actual complete weighted prime sum minus continuum equals -integral_0^L (psi(exp y)-exp y)exp(-y/2)(Fprime-F/2)dy.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: Applies directly to the corrected-source test of any constructed finite even input, including a fixed-input echo projection if its precise coefficient vector is supplied. No ground premise is needed.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: The test depends on the actual input. This exact identity does not supply an upper bound on the joint psi-error/test covariance. No exchange of the corrected row with the raw fixed H function is licensed.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Membership needs a genuine norm budget U and actual derivative variation V. The response consumer additionally assumes UniformPrimeDiscrepancyBound and an Arch-continuum budget B. Ground-ray norm pricing requires a strict opposite-ground gap.
interfaces.existing_result: The test amplitude is 2||correctedRow||U; the complete source norm is <=B+epsilon when both independent arithmetic and continuum hypotheses are supplied.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This gives a ready exact consumer for a new estimate on the fixed echo input, but does not itself produce that estimate.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: Do not promote the proposition UniformPrimeDiscrepancyBound into a theorem stored in a ground packet. No missing inverse cost is alleged; strict-gap norm pricing is already proved.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Same L>0,K>=3 and the corresponding actual bottom strictly below the opposite bottom; the theorem chooses its actual normalized eigenray/reciprocal input.
interfaces.existing_result: Strict even: f(r)=1, Prime(r)=-1-Arch(r), positive real M4 and gap*||Dr||^2<=Re M4. Strict odd: distinct reciprocal EVEN v has f(v)=-1 and Prime(v)=1-Arch(v). Gap budgets keep opposite trace signs.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: These are actual source constraints beyond the fixed-input echo calculation. They become directly relevant only after an eigenray identity or a fully priced spectral decomposition relating the fixed echo inputs to these selected rays.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: The constructed H-translate, its primitive and its repaired projection are not identified with these rays. Source activity alone does not establish an eigen-equation, moment positivity, or response estimate.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Actual BothNeutralNegative at the identical L,K, with positive aperture and K>=3.
interfaces.existing_result: Exhaustive strict-even, strict-odd or shared-bottom package retains absolute energies, full reciprocal inputs, whole kernels and source-forced complement responses.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: The fixed echo analysis must remain compatible with this package when a common negative state is separately supplied. It is not free-source data.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: None of the fields is an independently proved contrary arithmetic sign. A fixed-input squared response cannot inherit a selected eigenmode equation or an own-predecessor PSD property.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: One actual nontrivial zero rho with Re rho!=1/2. A positive constant margin and eventual threshold are chosen before all later apertures.
interfaces.existing_result: At exact Kd=ceil(L^4), both actual parity bottoms are <=-d; actual even M4-zero and odd M3/M5-zero nonzero trials have a fixed relative negative margin.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This is stronger than merely cofinal negativity and is not inferred from a fixed input response. It supplies the correct same-aperture negative spectrum on the whole late tail.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: It does not say the echo input overlaps a negative eigenspace by any quantitative amount, nor that either negative trial is the H-translate. Constant negative Rayleigh depth is not a growing exponential depth.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Actual off-line rho; first R0, then any 0<beta<|Re rho-1/2|, parity and R>=R0; reconstruct the genuine composed output packet.
interfaces.existing_result: The same packet keeps a unit detector with energy<=-exp(beta L), both negative grounds at Kd, all-cutoff zero regularity, and complete even/odd spectral disjointness for every 3<=K<=Kd.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This pays the historical source-audit seam that regular selection alone did not preserve an existing deep packet. No external equality of unrelated packets is needed.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: This selected-aperture conclusion is not universal separation at every L,K. No determinant lower bound, gap size or source-overlap lower magnitude is supplied.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Actual full cross-parity spectral disjointness at the same L,K and a nonzero actual eigenvector; arbitrary complex eigenvalue retained.
interfaces.existing_result: Every even eigenvector is visible to corrected f and the inverse-adjoint cubic channel; every odd eigenvector is visible to cubic g and f composed with D^-1. All eigenspaces have dimension<=1.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This is a real kernel exclusion beyond generic finite injectivity, but for these exact source functionals. It can exclude a source-silent eigenray at a selected separated state.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: It does not identify translates of H with either source functional. An H-translate observation kernel is not proved contained in ker f or ker g. Neither qualitative visibility nor simplicity bounds recovery conditioning.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Finite-dimensional Hilbert input and actual bounded observation maps P,C; kernel inclusion ker P intersect ker C <= ker ell must be supplied.
interfaces.existing_result: Recovery exists exactly under that kernel inclusion. Its optimal norm is sup ||ell x||/||(Px,Cx)|| on the nonzero complete observation, using the Hilbert product norm.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: If a joint echo/history observation is explicitly instantiated, this theorem gives the correct test for exact recovery and the exact remaining norm quantity.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: No blanket kernel inclusion or uniformly bounded inverse is proved for arbitrary chosen observations. A full source cyclicity theorem for f,g does not automatically prove H-translate observation recovery.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: |phase|<=1, separation a>=0, and an actual native pole-neutral vector v at the original aperture; arbitrary finite cutoff.
interfaces.existing_result: Full original prime forcing against exact physical synthesis is <=16*fixedOriginalSincTrialNormalization*||v||*sqrt(integral_0^L nativeOriginalPrimeField^2). The compact differential inverse and physical isometry are paid.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: Already a valid full-history forcing estimate on genuine native test vectors. It could consume an independently improved L2 estimate, not merely a primitive head or signed mean.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: The RHS is the one-copy original field and its full positive L2 energy. It is not the signed H-field self-echo; no rate-zero bound is supplied or inferred by discarding histories.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Every fixed native source order d and every C>1, continuous real horizons; complete multiplicity-bearing source.
interfaces.existing_result: log(1+integral_[T-C log T,T]|primeFieldFamily d|^2)/(2T) tends to nativeZeroDisplacementSup.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This quantifies the exact growth that any proposed L2 supplier must beat and preserves the actual source.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: It proves the rate Theta, not Theta=0. The source H=q*j adapter is separate from silently replacing one-copy j by H.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Actual Step123NativeOutput beta parity separation, beta>0, universal lateness before packet parameters.
interfaces.existing_result: Full detector loss differs from smoothSourceMain by every fixed exponential smallness; late smoothSourceMain>exp(beta L)/4.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: A contrary bound can bypass ground selection, but must target the actual inverse-weighted forcing minus direct Weil energy minus eta mass.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: Current fixed-input echo is not this expression. The direct energy and complete predecessor forcing cannot be discarded; paid compact inverse does not pay the response comparison.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Right actual zero for the separation theorem; an explicit finite-trial approximation sequence for the RH consumer.
interfaces.existing_result: Every finite residual has a positive source-dependent lower norm at the actual zero. A fixed physical filter is nonzero there; no inverse filtering is used.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: This route remains available independently of eigenray projection and could consume a genuine small residual construction.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: The approximation sequence is OPEN. Recovering coefficients or exact source echo identities supplies no such convergence or normal-family control.

interfaces.exact_prerequisites: Definitions quantify over the exact historical globally aligned residual states, including their source and negative certificate.
interfaces.existing_result: The universal old prime-dominance gate is equivalent to residual-state exclusion and exact Mathlib RH.
interfaces.application_to_current_echo: An equivalent formulation is a usable consumer but not an independent arithmetic supplier. Its actual carrier and global alignment cannot be transferred from an arbitrary fixed echo input.
interfaces.unpaid_or_invalid_transfer: This does not establish impossibility of a new source argument; it prevents counting a renamed universal dominance premise as paid information.

metadata_interpretation: Older SOURCE_CONSTRAINTS state rules and REGULAR_CELLS entries describe their historical seams. Current PacketSpectralSelection and the newer source-audit full-spectrum extension pay same-packet disjoint selection; they do not pay all-aperture spectral separation or quantitative overlap. Current source types take precedence over old prose.
highest_leverage_exact_remaining: For fixed-input echo coefficients, retain complete concentration, full Arch action, both output-normal costs and cross-prime covariance. For eigenray closure, prove an actual-source bound on the normalized selected corrected test or a quantitative observation link to that selected state. Generic recovery and RH-equivalent gate formulations provide neither bound.
